note: One entry per FR3 (roadmap B2). Every entry point that drives an arm names the arm (or its IP) explicitly; nothing falls back to a default arm. robot_ip and corenetic_device_id must equal the arm's replay_config (checked by fr3_arms.validate); corenetic_device_id is null, with no_gripper_why, for a bare flange. payload is the end-effector load Desk should hold for the arm as it is mounted now; null = not declared, and preflight then only reports what Desk holds. start_joints_rad is where move_to_start takes the arm. Left and right are the arms' own: stand behind the bases facing where they face. 10-26: the arm that was 'right' until then (192.168.11.102, the registered one) is the left; the new arm went in to its right.

placement.source: tape 10-30: base centres 0.66 m apart, parallel, no fore-aft offset; carts 5 cm off the table edge, table top 10 cm above them. Not B3: sigma stays the unknown-placement 20 mm until the arm-arm ball edge exists.

right.gripper_note: 11-02: the corenetic gripper is on this arm. Its BOX was 596523097 until the v4.1 firmware (10-31) renumbered every BOX (the handheld 1819152274 is now 3906437858); both report sn box_collection_controller_000001, so tell them apart by device_id.
right.start_source: panda_py constants.JOINT_POSITION_START, as the left arm
right.payload_note: null since 11-02: the gripper is mounted, so the bare-flange 0 kg (10-26) no longer holds; declare what F2 identifies for gripper + insert (10-12 on the then-right arm: m_ee 1.111 kg, F_x_Cee (16.8, -22.2, 60.9) mm with gripper + SMR). Out of its transport pose 10-26 (j4 had been past the FR3 limit). Placement not final: no base edge yet (B0/B3).

left.no_gripper_why: 11-02: its gripper (BOX 596523097, 3100715645 since the v4.1 firmware) went to the right arm; the flange is bare.
left.start_source: panda_py constants.JOINT_POSITION_START (what Panda.move_to_start() used before B2)

payload.source: bare flange, Desk end effector cleared 10-26 (it had held the Franka Hand default, 0.73 kg)

left.payload_note: Gripper away for repair 10-23, back on the right arm 11-02. 10-12 Desk held m_ee 1.111 kg, F_x_Cee (16.8, -22.2, 60.9) mm with gripper + SMR (outputs/fr3_payload/20261012_154421_fr3_smr_in.json on Thor). The base was moved 10-26 and is not in its final place: the world -> fr3_base edge on Thor is stale until it is registered again.
